text:
Driving to this place requires one to go through automatic barrier gate of the main building and heading towards the car park at the back.
Beautifully designed structure (metal frames) with plenty of greenery around and at the center courtyard.
Car park is free for the first 15 minutes, and fees start adding up afterwards.
I was out within 20 minutes (due to long queue time at the bakery shop), and I had to pay THB20 for the car park on exit.
My visit was only for buying a specific item from the bakery and from that location (second floor) I couldn’t see anything interesting around and seemed like most visitors come to the same spot where I was too.

text:
Dadfa Lasalle is a popular local Thai restaurant located in the Lasalle area of Bangkok. The restaurant is well known for its authentic Thai street food and flavorful dishes that attract both local residents and visitors.

At Dadfa Lasalle, customers can enjoy a variety of Thai dishes such as spicy salads, stir-fried seafood, grilled meats, and traditional Thai soups. The food is known for its rich taste, fresh ingredients, and generous portions.

The restaurant has a casual and friendly atmosphere, making it a great place for families and friends to enjoy a meal together. Because of its delicious food and reasonable prices, Dadfa Lasalle is a favorite dining spot for people who want to experience authentic Thai flavors in Bangkok.

I scanned my parking ticket inside the restaurant after finishing my meal.
But I was still charged when driving out. I don't know if it's a trick or what, because I saw the male employee key in the license plate number incorrectly. If you didn't notice, you might think the card scan at the restaurant wasn't successful. When I pointed it out, they called the manager. For example, they keyed in license plate 5178 as 5718.
It's a waste of time to have to drive around to scan the card again, so I had to pay, even though the employee should have tried keying in the correct license plate number first. But when the manager arrived, they said it couldn't be fixed because it was already keyed in incorrectly, and the customer had to pay. So I paid, but I won't be using their service again. Please be careful, this has happened twice.
